comparison.objective: Pack a pharmaceutical shipper in the safe vertical order gel brick, thermal buffer, then medication carton, preventing direct refrigerant–medicine contact; not damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual-compatible rigid-object grasping, transport, planar alignment, and constrained stacking in a cavity. It lacks tool insertion, fastener release, fine collar tuning, torque control, physical cycle actuation, and diagnosis from repeated impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Full credit requires all three components seated in order, tilt under 4°, zero brick–carton contact, arms at standby, and a 3-second hold; hazardous direct contact caps the score at 0.25. The spec does not state explicit seating-depth or wall-clearance acceptance thresholds, but its ordering/contact rubric is clearly unrelated to damping performance.
comparison.reason: It evaluates safe layered packing and contact avoidance, while the candidate evaluates adjustment, locking, and repeatable dynamic stopping under a quantified energy and velocity envelope.
